Lesson/material

/courses/:courseId/modules/:moduleId/lessons/:lessonId
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S04

Read a published lesson or material with accessible media, source/version facts and a clear next step. Opening a resource is distinct from completing an authored learning requirement.

Stay in lessonOpen external material
Permissions
  • Only published accessible versions appear to learners.
  • A replaced resource does not mutate submitted assessment snapshots.
  • Course AI/software prohibition remains visible beside related tools.
Responsive
  • Single reading column; media scales within width and equation overflow has an accessible alternative.
  • Footer actions wrap; sticky controls cannot cover body content.
Accessibility
  • Images have authored descriptions; videos have captions/transcript; math uses semantic alternatives.
  • Completion and playback have independent labels; focus stays stable during media loading.
Data
  • Lesson/module IDs, published version, content blocks and file references.
  • Own completion requirement state; next-item availability and related academic links.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Download uses the displayed version even after another draft is authored.
  • A viewer failure still offers permitted download/alternative paths.
  • Opening the page cannot automatically satisfy a manual completion requirement.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
